name: material-text-styles
negative_note: Compose keeps text at its natural font metrics — the node bounds stay asc+desc and the baseline sits at the natural ascent regardless of lineHeight — while slint's `line-height` hard-sets the line box and parley splits the leading half above/half below, so element h differs by the lineHeight-vs-natural gap and glyph ink lands ~1-3px off vertically inside its cells. Parley also appends letter-spacing after the trailing cluster (+up to one tracking unit of advance vs Compose).
